title: feat(triage): start a run only for events the workflow acts on
body:
First step of coalescing triage triggers (CL-XXXX). Production records showed each pull request triaged about six times within minutes, mostly from events nothing acts on.

- One shared event filter in the contracts package, used by both the webhook bridge and the workflow. A check run counts only when it completes; label, assign, lock, milestone and similar pull request actions, edited or dismissed reviews, and edited or deleted comments map to no event. The bridge answers those deliveries with 202 ignored before any database lookup and records the delivery so GitHub does not retry. A re-requested review counts as an update, so it still brings a handled pull request back.
- Facts carry the run's events as a list, and a pack action wakes when its When includes any of them; manual, batch and catch-up runs are unchanged.

Verified: `bun run check`; contracts, workflow, hub and web tests, including check run created and in progress mapping to nothing and completed to checks, a labeled and a check run created delivery ignored while completed and synchronize produce exactly two mails, and an action waking on any listed event; the workflow bundle builds deterministically with a new content version.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: feat(triage): start a run only for events the workflow acts on
